title: Green Rewards Card: Understanding Your Carbon Footprint Report
summary: Explains the Green Rewards Card monthly “Carbon Footprint” report: summary (categorized spend, estimated emissions, total offsets), category emissions analysis with variance, offset details using a $0.06 per-dollar rate, and net impact (emissions minus offsets) for the reporting window. Covers how offsets are calculated (eligible spend × $0.06; returns/credits reduce eligible spend), how to reconcile with card ledger/adjust vendor category mappings, and how to export/share the report.
faqs: What sections are included in my Green Rewards carbon footprint report (summary, category analysis, offset details, net impact)?
How often are these carbon footprint reports delivered, and what activity do they cover?
How is the CO₂ offset amount calculated (including the $0.06 per-dollar rate) and how do returns/credits affect it?
How do I reconcile the report’s “eligible spend” to my card ledger for the same monthly period?
What should I review in category mappings for large vendors to ensure the correct emissions factors were used?
How can I export and share the report while keeping emissions and financial records aligned?
keywords: Summary page (categorized spend, estimated emissions, total offsets)
Offset formula: eligible spend × $0.06 (pounds of CO₂)
Returns and credits reduce eligible spend
Net impact = emissions minus applied offsets
